maria_p: Heads-up — planning a dual-write cutover tonight 22:30 UTC for user_profiles (EU+US overlap). Slot 22:30-23:30 UTC. Need owners for cutover, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Who can own the deploy and smoke?

sam_platform: I can own cutover + smoke. Will be online by 22:15 UTC. @kevin_db can you prepare DB rollback artifacts (snapshot + quick restore steps)?

kevin_db: Yes, I'll take DB prep. Pre-backup scheduled for 22:00 UTC. Snapshot command I'll run: `pg_basebackup -h db-primary -D /backups/slot-2107654321`

jordan_sre: I'll handle infra monitoring and alerting. Planning a 1% canary at 22:25 UTC to validate routing and KV cache behavior. @ella_oncall can you cover logs/alerts during the window?

ella_oncall: Oncall available — I'll stay until 00:00 UTC. Adding myself to the PagerDuty rotation for that window. Please ping me if CPU or error rate spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `dualwrite-user_profiles-migration-v3` -> canary 22:25 UTC -> prod 22:30 UTC. Notifying owners: @sam_platform @kevin_db @jordan_sre

maria_p: Quick checklist to confirm:
- pre-backup complete (22:00)
- migration applied to staging + green smoke
- canary at 22:25 (1%)
- full switch at 22:30, keep dual-write for 1 hour post-cutover
- smoke tests: read/write, FK/index validation, small query perf check
- rollback if error rate >5% or data divergence detected

sam_platform: I'll post the exact smoke test commands 30m before cutover. Also note: migration includes removal of legacy index on profiles.email — if the drop fails we abort and keep dual-write. @kevin_db ack?

kevin_db: Ack. Preparing rollback user and tested `pg_restore` path. SQL toggle snippet to flip writes if needed: `BEGIN; UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled = true WHERE name = 'new_write_path'; COMMIT;` — will use a transaction wrapper during cutover.

jordan_sre: Rollback sequence (ops):
1) scale down api-new deployment to 0
2) revert routing weight in envoy / load balancer
3) re-enable old write path (feature flag)
I'll put exact kubectl/DNS commands in the runbook.

maria_p: :thumbsup: Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can commit to the window. I'll update the calendar invite and post a final ops note 1 hour before.

sam_platform: :white_check_mark:

kevin_db: :white_check_mark: will keep DB connection open for quick restores

ella_oncall: :white_check_mark: oncall; will watch logs and paging

jordan_sre: :white_check_mark: will prep runbook snippets and escalation steps

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 60m and 10m before cutover. Good luck!

maria_p: Thanks everyone — leaving this thread pinned. I'll post the staging smoke output ~21:30 UTC and final checklist at 21:45 UTC. If anything changes DM me or ping here.
__note: This file is a synthetic Slack thread for eng-platform about dual-write migration coordination. Messages are short, Slack-style, with @mentions and inline code.
